settings.question: How long does delivery take?
settings.answer: EU orders ship in 24h from Lisbon and arrive in two to four working days. Rest of world, five to nine.

settings.question: What is your return window?
settings.answer: Sixty days, opened or not. We pay return shipping inside the EU.

settings.question: Can I use two actives together?
settings.answer: Usually yes, on alternate days. Write to us with both products and we will give you an order.

settings.question: Are you certified cruelty-free?
settings.answer: Leaping Bunny certified since 2024, with an audited supply chain at every tier.
